verdict.rationale: getSandbox() gets or creates an isolated sandbox by ID in a single SDK call, and the docs say each sandbox runs in its own VM or container with a full Linux environment. The 'live in seconds' part is not documented: community comments mention boot times only for other Firecracker setups, not for Cloudflare. Missing for 10: documented or measured cold-start/provisioning time, independent hands-on corroboration of how fast a sandbox becomes usable.
